title: JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol binding
summary: JSON-RPC Fabric dev3 handles JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, notifications, errors, batches and framed optional transports. Its legacy connector registry is separated as opt-in compatibility; Connect Selector is the preferred routing authority.
invariants: jsonrpc/id/method/params/error remain JSON-RPC wire-owned, not shared SOAP/gRPC frames.
Notification transport send success is neither application completion nor durable acknowledgment.
No production external authorization, HTTP/WebSocket/QUIC bridge or durable Queue Fabric semantic equivalence is claimed in dev3.

provenance.claim: Source inspected locally in exact package bytes.
